claim: A real Chromium browser context locally generated and pinned-snarkjs-verified Groth16 proofs for all three exact low128-v0 actions, but exceeded the frozen browser process-memory budget.
commands: local-only static UMD browser harness invoking snarkjs.groth16.fullProve
pinned snarkjs CLI groth16 verify for every browser proof

measurements.scope: direct Chromium process tree RSS sum, 50 ms samples; Node harness and loopback server excluded

tests.name: exact browser Groth16 corpus
tests.expected: browser proof and public signals for each exact action verify under pinned local snarkjs
tests.observed: deposit, transfer, and withdrawal all generated and verified; hashes retained in result summary

tests.name: browser time budget
tests.expected: each initial sample no more than 60000 ms

tests.name: browser process-memory budget
tests.expected: direct browser process tree no more than 2097152 KiB

tests.name: p95 target-hardware qualification
tests.expected: fixed isolated hardware and qualifying distribution
tests.observed: not run; one sample per action on one non-isolated host

limitations: Initial feasibility only; not p95 qualification.
RSS process-tree summation is conservative because shared browser pages may be counted in more than one process.
Development-only setup; no ceremony or production claim.
No BCH node, funding, broadcast, network artifact retrieval, or hosted proving was used.
